Headline: #26 South Shore Express buses Temporary Reroute at 106th/Torrence
ShortDescription: #26 South Shore Express buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to construction near 106th/Torrence.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Southbound #26 South Shore Express buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Torrence, 104th, Muskeegon, 106th and over regular route, due to construction near 106th/Torrence.

Allow extra travel time.
